استكثرن (form X)
# اِسْتَكْثَرْنَ (istakṯarna) /is.tak.θar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اُسْتُكْثِرْنَ (ustukṯirna) /us.tuk.θir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اِسْتَكْثِرْنَ (istakṯirna) /is.tak.θir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
